review_scope: Adversarial review of actual historical G variables, compatibility, first-zero-arrival boundary, rank and local-support counts, and q=8 all-unit movement-only threshold. No full-word, all-width, or kappa claim.

review_findings.local_generalized_inverse_formula: PASS under the complement construction; `(I-DR)W=0` is necessary and retained, and `T_C=h_C P_in` is an actual coordinate, not an arbitrary observation.
review_findings.first_zero_arrival_boundary: PASS under source-at-positive-lines, zero-started-cache, monotone-packet, and no-Y-feedback premises. First-arrival values avoid loss through a singular later zero-cell map; a pre-CLEAR terminal is not an equivalent boundary.
review_findings.historical_rank_upper_bound: rank(A)<=rank(G)<=qV+sum_C nu_C<=8qV; each packet visits at most one chart at each nonzero proper dimension 1..7.
review_findings.refined_facet_union_transition: PASS conditional on canonical foreign support. At each Fi, local remainder lies in the union of Y_i's last proper chart, X predecessor charts, and packet successor charts; the independent universal E7 bound 52 versus actual support minimum 55 forces r_i+s_i>=2. Summing 222 required visits contradicts the 111+9=120 available visits.
review_findings.fitting_rigidity_scope: Scalar characteristic-two rank-nine rigidity yields rank(A)>=10. For all V, the arbitrary singular-Schur stratum remains open; no 10V claim is made.
review_findings.unit_movement_profile: 111 X line-to-Hub routes plus 111 Y zero-to-facet routes plus 8 Hub-to-zero packet routes, all split into rank-one steps, have movement moment 1618.
review_findings.fixed_even_m_threshold: From exact pinned histograms, the Q movement allowance is (N-H)_t + m/(36(m-1))*(T2-P2)_t; its real threshold for 1618 is bracketed near 4.28858525225, so m=6 is the first even m passing. m=4 falls short by >0.360816237295; m=6 has >1.28386234208 movement-only margin.
review_findings.limitations: The 1618 comparison is not a lower bound for jump-based schedules and is not sufficient for a causal word. No construction, source/restoration, ADD/INIT/lifetime invoice, full Q contract, all-width admission, or kappa follows.
